name: Page
description: A page of the docs library app (forge 35a-2): one document file in a Volume (pages/<id>.doc.json) with its place in the Volume's page tree, its icon and cover, and its trash. The tree is held here, never in folders: moving a page changes parent, ancestors and rank and never renames its file. Change pages through the docs.page.* commands and the createPage tool, which keep the tree whole; a Volume's grants are the floor of who may read and change its pages.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The page's title; Untitled when empty

fields.name: Icon
fields.description: An emoji shown before the title

fields.name: Icon image
fields.description: An uploaded image used as the icon in place of the emoji

fields.name: Cover
fields.description: An uploaded image shown across the top of the page

fields.name: Volume
fields.description: The id of the Volume holding the page's document (kb.volumes)

fields.name: File
fields.description: The page's document, pages/<id>.doc.json in its Volume

fields.name: Parent
fields.description: The id of the page it sits under; empty at the top of its Volume

fields.name: Ancestors
fields.description: The ids of the pages above it, the top first; kept by the page commands, so a subtree is one query and a move into its own subtree is refused

fields.name: Subpages
fields.description: How many subpages it has outside the trash, for the tree's expand arrow; kept by the page commands

fields.name: Position
fields.description: Its place among its parent's subpages

fields.name: Template
fields.description: A template: listed under Templates, copied by createPage

fields.name: Database
fields.description: The entity type of the database the page shows (35c-3); empty for a document page

fields.name: Trashed at
fields.description: When it went to the trash; empty when it is not in the trash

fields.name: Trashed with
fields.description: The page whose trashing took it (itself for the page trashed), so restoring that page brings back what went with it and no more

fields.name: Last saved
fields.description: When its document file was last written (page.saved)

fields.name: Hash
fields.description: The SHA-256 of its document file as last saved
